response.sql: WITH member_by_major AS (SELECT link_to_major as major_id, COUNT(*) as member_count FROM member WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_major), total_members AS (SELECT SUM(member_count) as total FROM member_by_major) SELECT major_id, member_count, member_count * 1.0 / total as share FROM member_by_major, total_members ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10;
